title: blacklist.events BLACKLIST_ENTRY_UPSERTED v1 (envelope.data)
description: Compacted topic, no tombstones. aggregateType BlacklistEntry; key = aggregateId = entryId. Emitted when a BLACK entry becomes ACTIVE (approval), INACTIVE (deactivation approved) or EXPIRED (expiry job, <= 1 min). Never for PENDING_APPROVAL / REJECTED entries, never for whitelist entries. An inactive entry stays on the topic as active = false.

valueHash.description: kernel K2 HMAC over the normalised value; WALLET/PARTNER over the lower-case UUID
